description: This Java class defines an immutable implementation of the PipelineElement interface called PipelineElementResolved, which encapsulates a resolved value in a processing pipeline. It provides methods for handling the resolved value, applying functions, iterating over the value, and integrating with visitor patterns.

classes.name: PipelineElementResolved
classes.description: Immutable class representing a pipeline element with a resolved value. Provides methods for transformation, iteration, and visitor acceptance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new PipelineElementResolved instance with the specified value.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the pipeline element, specifically RESOLVED.

methods.name: onResolved
methods.description: Applies a function to the resolved value, returning the resulting PipelineElement.

methods.name: onUnresolved
methods.description: Returns this element, because it is resolved; does not change.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Returns this element, as it is resolved; no deletion behavior.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor and invokes its 'resolved' method with the value.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the single value contained.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the contained value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the contained value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
